words.sense: A very deep physical gap or a vast figurative separation.
misconceptions: Any big disagreement is a schism even if the group stays together.

words.sense: A formal or lasting division within a group caused by disagreement over beliefs or loyalties.
misconceptions: A group’s formal breakup is only a large difference of opinion.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the focus is a great distance between things or a group dividing into rival bodies.

edges.boundary_rule: A chasm is a deep gap or gulf; a schism is a group’s break into factions over beliefs or loyalties.

misconceptions.M1: Any big disagreement is a schism even if the group stays together.
misconceptions.M2: A group’s formal breakup is only a large difference of opinion.
misconceptions.M3: Physical size and organizational division are the same kind of gap.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the break in Kiran’s walking route?

beats.text: Kiran stops where the path ends at a dark opening in the earth, with the far side several metres away.
beats.reason: The situation shows deep gap in the ground, which points to chasm.

beats.text: Looking down, Kiran cannot see the bottom.
beats.decisive_clue: deep physical opening with no visible bottom
beats.reason: A literal land gap is a chasm, not a split among people.

chains.feedback_short: Deep physical opening with no visible bottom: chasm fits better.
chains.feedback_deep: A chasm is a deep gap or gulf; a schism is a group’s break into factions over beliefs or loyalties. Here, a literal land gap is a chasm, not a split among people.
chains.contrast_rule: Chasm separates sides; schism splits a group.

hints.attention: Is the separation in the ground or a group?

hints.contrast: Chasm separates sides; schism splits a group.
